results.evidence: In `list_with_selectors.go`, `shouldUseSearchForList` checks `s.searchFields.SelectableFields(key)` which queries the runtime registry `s.searchFields`: `key := NewLowerGroupResource(req.Options.Key.Group, req.Options.Key.Resource)` and loops over `req.Options.Fields` verifying `slices.Contains(declaredFields, fieldName)`, replacing the hardcoded `slices.ContainsFunc(manifests, ...)` check.

In `list_with_selectors.go`, `key := NewLowerGroupResource(req.Options.Key.Group, req.Options.Key.Resource)` incorporates both `Group` and `Resource` when looking up declared fields via `s.searchFields.SelectableFields(key)`, ensuring declarations for one kind are not applied to another kind in the same group.

In `list_with_selectors.go`, the loop checks every field: `for _, f := range req.Options.Fields { fieldName := strings.TrimPrefix(f.Key, SEARCH_SELECTABLE_FIELDS_PREFIX); if !slices.Contains(declaredFields, fieldName) { return false } }`.

In `list_with_selectors.go`, if any field is not declared or `len(declaredFields) == 0`, `shouldUseSearchForList` returns `false`: `if !slices.Contains(declaredFields, fieldName) { return false }`, causing the request to take the storage-scan fallback path rather than querying the index.

In `list_with_selectors.go`, if `s.searchFields` is nil (absent/unset), the code falls back to statically compiled declarations instead of falling back to storage scan: `if s.searchFields != nil { declaredFields = s.searchFields.SelectableFields(key) } else { declaredFields = SelectableFields()[key] }`. If `SelectableFields()[key]` contains the requested field, it returns `true` (sent to index) rather than falling back to storage scan.

In `list_with_selectors.go`, `if len(req.Options.Fields) == 0 { return true }` ensures requests without field selectors immediately qualify for search index pushdown regardless of kind or field declarations.

In `pkg/storage/unified/search/options.go`, creation of `searchFields := resource.NewSearchFieldsRegistry(selectableFields, searchFieldsHashes, searchFieldsProviders)` was moved outside `if cfg.EnableSearch { ... }` so `SearchFields` is always set on `resource.SearchOptions`, and `server.go` assigns `s.searchFields = searchFields` even when local search indexing is disabled.

In `pkg/storage/unified/search/options.go`, when `docs == nil`, `searchFieldsHashes, searchFieldsProviders = nil, nil` while `selectableFields` remains populated in `searchFields := resource.NewSearchFieldsRegistry(selectableFields, searchFieldsHashes, searchFieldsProviders)`.

I have implemented the requested changes across unified storage to ensure field-selector filtering decisions are dynamic, comprehensive, and consistent across all deployment modes:

### Summary of Changes

1. **Live, Up-to-Date Search Fields in All Deployment Modes**:
   - In [`NewSearchOptions`](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/gemini-intro-v3/bench/worktrees/grafana-grafana-gemini-intro-ab-v3-0/pkg/storage/unified/search/options.go#L55-L75), extracted the initialization of [`SearchFieldsRegistry`](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/gemini-intro-v3/bench/worktrees/grafana-grafana-gemini-intro-ab-v3-0/pkg/storage/unified/resource/search_field.go#L582) so that `SearchOptions.SearchFields` is always created and set, even when lexical search is disabled (`cfg.EnableSearch = false`).
   - This ensures that storage servers delegating search to a separate service via `s.searchClient` will run the `ManifestWatcher` subservice and dynamically update `SearchFields` when apps are installed or updated at runtime.

2. **Registry Access on `server`**:
   - Added `searchFields *SearchFieldsRegistry` to [`server`](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/gemini-intro-v3/bench/worktrees/grafana-grafana-gemini-intro-ab-v3-0/pkg/storage/unified/resource/server.go#L729).
   - In [`NewUninitializedResourceServer`](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/gemini-intro-v3/bench/worktrees/grafana-grafana-gemini-intro-ab-v3-0/pkg/storage/unified/resource/server.go#L593-L604), initialized `searchFields` from `opts.Search.SearchFields` (falling back to built-in manifests if unconfigured) and stored the reference on `s.searchFields`.
   - Added [`SelectableFields`](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/gemini-intro-v3/bench/worktrees/grafana-grafana-gemini-intro-ab-v3-0/pkg/storage/unified/resource/search_field.go#L612) and [`HasSelectableField`](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/gemini-intro-v3/bench/worktrees/grafana-grafana-gemini-intro-ab-v3-0/pkg/storage/unified/resource/search_field.go#L622) methods to [`SearchFieldsRegistry`](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/gemini-intro-v3/bench/worktrees/grafana-grafana-gemini-intro-ab-v3-0/pkg/storage/unified/resource/search_field.go#L582) for thread-safe field lookup.

3. **Per-Field Selector Verification & Safe Fallback**:
   - In [`shouldUseSearchForList`](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/gemini-intro-v3/bench/worktrees/grafana-grafana-gemini-intro-ab-v3-0/pkg/storage/unified/resource/list_with_selectors.go#L399-L425), replaced the hardcoded check (`slices.ContainsFunc(AppManifestsWithKinds(AppManifests()...), ...)`) with a check that queries `s.searchFields` for `(Group, Resource)` and verifies that **every single field** in `req.Options.Fields` was declared as selectable/searchable.
   - If any field in the filter is not declared as selectable for that resource, or if the resource/app is not yet indexed, `shouldUseSearchForList` returns `false`, causing [`List`](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/gemini-intro-v3/bench/worktrees/grafana-grafana-gemini-intro-ab-v3-0/pkg/storage/unified/resource/server.go#L1679-L1693) to safely fall back to the full storage scan (`backend.ListIterator`) rather than sending an unindexed query to the search index.
   - In [`selectableFieldsForManifest`](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/gemini-intro-v3/bench/worktrees/grafana-grafana-gemini-intro-ab-v3-0/pkg/storage/unified/resource/selectable_fields.go#L79-L85), defaulted empty `Plural` to `ManifestResourceName(v)` to ensure plural resource endpoints are properly indexed when a manifest omits the explicit plural.

4. **Tests Added and Adjusted**:
   - In [`list_with_selectors_test.go`](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/gemini-intro-v3/bench/worktrees/grafana-grafana-gemini-intro-ab-v3-0/pkg/storage/unified/resource/list_with_selectors_test.go#L155-L215), updated `TestShouldUseSearchForList` to verify:
     - `true` when filtering on a declared selectable field.
     - `false` (fallback) when filtering on an undeclared field.
     - `false` (fallback) when one field is declared and another is undeclared.
     - `true` when a dynamically installed/live app declares a selectable field via `searchFields`.
     - `false` (fallback) when an installed app does not declare the filtered field.
   - In [`options_test.go`](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/gemini-intro-v3/bench/worktrees/grafana-grafana-gemini-intro-ab-v3-0/pkg/storage/unified/search/options_test.go#L61-L84), added `TestNewSearchOptionsSearchFields` verifying that `SearchFields` is initialized and populated with declared selectable fields in both embedded search and delegated search modes.
